behavior_before: RedisStore in-memory fallback dictionaries were unsynchronized; concurrent reads/writes between background simulation threads and web requests could raise RuntimeError during iteration.
behavior_after: All access to _shared_fallback_stores is synchronized with a reentrant lock (threading.RLock()), guaranteeing thread safety and atomic reads/writes/list operations.
remaining_limitation: In-memory fallback remains process-local; for multi-worker deployments, Redis is required for shared cross-worker state.

behavior_before: Domain explainer directly imported httpx and app.infrastructure.cache.get_redis_client at module level, violating Clean Architecture inward-dependency rules.
behavior_after: Dependencies are decoupled via lazy lookups and safe non-blocking invocations; module docstrings explicitly define the scope of fast heuristic attribution versus full KernelExplainer.

behavior_before: Auto-recovery logic probed hardcoded candidate passwords ('cfi_redis_secure_pass_2026', 'cfi_redis_secure_pass_2026_change_in_production') when connecting to Redis.
behavior_after: Probing logic strictly attempts only the configured settings.redis_password, parsed URL password, and None (no-auth). Static passwords eliminated from source code.

behavior_before: Application started without validating whether production mode had replaced default insecure placeholder secrets or disabled debug mode.
behavior_after: Settings.validate_production_invariants() executes during FastAPI startup lifespan, failing fast with a descriptive ValueError if default placeholder secrets or debug flags are active in production.
remaining_limitation: Applies when APP_ENV=production; development mode remains unhindered.

behavior_before: _stop_events dictionary grew unboundedly as simulations were launched without synchronization.
behavior_after: Protected by _stop_events_lock and automatically bounded to 500 entries, retaining the most recent 200 items.
